This is the question of 3-torsion in D5/γ5 (Tahara: the exponent divides 6). The “paper” cells are closed thus: if Q/γ5 is metabelian, then D5=γ5 by Gupta–Tahara, and a non-metabelian group of class 4 and rank d has order ≥3d+5 (Proposition 6.5); for d=2 the factor γ2/γ3 is cyclic. The rest is the search up to 39. Open cells are hatched: there the case of Q/γ2 with at most one invariant >3 is proved (Theorem 6.8).
